prompt: Our Roblox place is in Team Create with two other people editing, and we haven't touched the collaborative editing settings. I'm going to have Claude rename a function across several scripts through the Studio MCP. Will my collaborators see those script edits right away, or only after I commit them?
truth: Right away. Drafts mode is off by default, so Live Scripting puts each edit in every collaborator's session at once. Warn them or save a version before the edit, since there is no commit step to hold it back.
trap: Only after you commit: script edits stay in your drafts until then.
result:
I can't tell you for sure, because it depends on which script-editing mode your place is in, and I couldn't confirm what the default is today.

**The two modes:**
- **Live scripting:** edits sync to collaborators in real time, and they see your cursor in the script. There's no commit step, so a rename done through the MCP would show up for them right away, including any half-finished state partway through. ([Roblox Developer Hub](https://developer.roblox.com/articles/Team-Create))
- **Drafts mode:** edits stay in your local Drafts window. Collaborators only see them after you select the scripts there and click **Commit**. ([Roblox Creator Docs](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/collaboration))

**Which one is the default?** The sources disagree and are out of date. A Roblox DevForum beta post said Live Scripting would become the Team Create default and could be switched per place ([DevForum](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/live-scripting-beta/2640607)). A 2023 third-party guide also said collaborative scripting was on by default ([Stealthy Gaming](https://stealthygaming.com/add-people-to-roblox-studio)). I found nothing current that settles it, so "we never changed the settings" doesn't tell you which mode you're in.

**How to check in about 30 seconds:** open a script while a collaborator has it open. If you see their colored cursor, you're in live mode. If changed scripts appear in the **Drafts** window (View → Drafts) waiting to be committed, you're in Drafts mode.

**What this means for the MCP rename:** the MCP edits scripts through your Studio session, so the edits follow whichever mode the place is in.
- **If you're in live mode:** collaborators will see each script change as it happens. They could also hit broken references between edits, or be typing in a script while it's being changed. Warn them first, or do the rename while they're out of the scripts involved.
- **If you're in Drafts mode:** nobody sees anything until you commit. Before you commit, use "Compare with server" to check for changes your collaborators made in the meantime ([Creator Docs](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/collaboration)).

You can switch modes, but one recent guide says switching requires collaborators to leave the session ([Obby.fun](https://www.obby.fun/blog/roblox-studio-team-create)).

Sources:
- [Team Create – Roblox Developer Hub](https://developer.roblox.com/articles/Team-Create)
- [Collaboration – Roblox Creator Docs](https://create.roblox.com/docs/studio/collaboration)
- [Live Scripting Beta – DevForum](https://devforum.roblox.com/t/live-scripting-beta/2640607)
- [Stealthy Gaming – Add people to Roblox Studio](https://stealthygaming.com/add-people-to-roblox-studio)
- [Obby.fun – Roblox Studio Team Create](https://www.obby.fun/blog/roblox-studio-team-create)
